margin/s: Scores again: cat three, dog five, ship minus one. The image is a cat, so y is zero.
margin/line: The multiclass SVM loss wants the right class to win by a margin of at least one. Draw a line one below cat's score, at two.
margin/poke: A wrong class that pokes above the line costs exactly how far it pokes. Dog, at five, is three above it.
margin/safe: Ship, far below the line, costs nothing. Its term is minus three, and the hinge clips it to zero: no credit for being low.
sum/formula: In symbols: for every wrong class j, take the larger of zero and s j, minus s y, plus one. Then add them up.
sum/skip: The right class is skipped. Its own term would always be one, a cost no score could ever remove.
sum/sum: Here that is three for dog, plus zero for ship. The loss is three.
zero/raise: Raise cat's score to seven. The line rises to six, above every other class.
zero/zero: Every term is zero, so the loss is zero. That takes beating every other class by at least one. Just winning is not enough.
